gen-dafont-neon-gf-pathway-extreme: Glowing, vibrant, and impossible to ignore. Neon draws every letter with a marker-nib line that ignores direction, while Pathway Extreme keeps its rounded shapes open beside stubby ascenders and a big x-height.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-questrial: Neon glows like stamped metal type, tall and loose. Neon is at its best when letters can shout with uniform line width, while Questrial is happiest keeping stencil-flat strokes open and quiet.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-radio-canada: Bright, buzzing, and impossible to ignore. Neon is best at spacing out tall, uniform-width letters for impact, while Radio Canada is best at holding steady lines with clear curve openings.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro keeps its terminals wide open and its weight steady. Neon's tall, glowing lowercase makes it the loud one, and the unvarying weight underneath lets that glow stand out.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Glowing and loud, Neon holds its t crossbar and stem to a single width, with generous spacing between every pair. Neon makes the statement; Schibsted Grotesk does the approachable talking.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-sofia-sans: Neon draws every letter as one glowing, unbroken line. Sofia Sans, a sans-serif with no thick-and-thin modulation, would read smoothly down a full page, its rounded letters clearly open at the side.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-sono: Loud glow first, then a gentle reply. Neon's true monoline drawing meets Sono's generous letter spacing and ajar lowercase a, so both keep plenty of room around every single letter.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-stack-sans-headline: Uninterrupted line width gives Neon its glow. The monoline skeleton of Stack Sans Headline echoes that single-width drawing, so the two feel drawn with one pen, the second far quieter.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch draws open curves you can see right into, with horizontals and verticals identical in thickness, like rod stock. Neon supplies the glow above while the sans keeps every word sturdy.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-tiktok-sans: TikTok Sans lifts its x-height almost to cap height. Neon is best at glowing, uniform-width display lettering, while TikTok Sans is best at keeping its c spacious and its lowercase tall.
